lead: Nirmala Sitharaman is best known as an Indian politician, born on 18 August 1959 in Madurai.
As of 2026, she is 67 years old, and her birth date places her under the Leo sign.
She has held the office of member of Rajya Sabha and Minister of Defence.
The sections that follow break down Nirmala Sitharaman's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Nirmala Sitharaman — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Nirmala Sitharaman was born on 18 August 1959 in Madurai, and holds Indian nationality.
She studied at Jawaharlal Nehru University.
She is recorded as speaking Tamil, Telugu and English.

sections.heading: Nirmala Sitharaman — Career and Professional Work
paras: Nirmala Sitharaman works primarily as a politician.

She has held the following offices: member of Rajya Sabha (2014–2016), Minister of Defence (2017–2019), Minister of Commerce and Industry (2014–2017), Minister of Finance (2019–present), Minister of Corporate Affairs (2019–present) and member of Rajya Sabha (2016–present). She is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.
She has taken part in World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2017.
